issue.title: Delivery QA audio provenance｜separate approval semantic identity from render cache identity
issue.description:
## Authoritative blocker

<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> post-VID36 formal Render `a1eef04442f74adeb603b1b6f11b2ba9` is technically successful and proves the intended GPU/cache fixes:

* approval currentity PASS, revision 8
* 17/17 fresh segment artifacts, `cache_hit=false`
* 17/17 `encoder_used=h264_nvenc`
* segment cache contract v5, encoder contract v2
* <issue id="af040022-b934-471a-97ef-4ac9c4784789" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-31/render-performancesource-ffprobe-去重與-fast-metadata-path">VID-31</issue> source probe behavior PASS: 2 fast probes + 15 reuse hits, 0 source-side deep counting scans
* Render Report / Final QC PASS
* black_flash PASS, interior long black count 0

Delivery QA run `0efe329e483e43258218f0fb1d8509fd` blocks only on `audio` provenance because all 17 reported segment cache keys differ from the keys recomputed from the approved manifest.

## Root cause

`delivery_qa._audio_render_provenance()` currently treats `build_segment_cache_key(manifest, segment)` as approval→render provenance identity and compares it byte-for-byte to `render_report.segments[*].cache_key`.

After <issue id="3ab58c7c-56b9-4bf2-a838-f78cdd67e6a4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-36/formal-render-segment-cache-must-bind-resolved-encoder-contract">VID-36</issue>, this is no longer a valid invariant:

* segment cache key is now a **rendered-artifact cache identity**;
* v5 intentionally includes runtime `encoder_cache_identity`;
* formal Render uses `resolved_contract` + encoder contract version/hash/implementation;
* approved manifest exists before runtime encoder resolution and therefore recomputes as `raw_request` identity.

Thus an unchanged approved segment/audio contract deterministically mismatches whenever runtime-only encoder/cache contract fields differ. This will also break legitimate future H.264 / HEVC / AV1 or encoder/cache contract upgrades if cache keys remain the approval provenance key.

## Required design

Separate two identities:

1. **Approval-semantic segment/audio provenance identity**
   * stable across runtime encoder/cache implementation changes;
   * derived only from immutable approved semantics actually relevant to proving the approved edit/audio was rendered;
   * ordered and deterministic.
2. **Rendered-artifact cache identity**
   * remains free to include encoder contract, renderer/cache version, diagnostics-excluded semantic contract hashes, etc.;
   * used only for artifact reuse/invalidation, not approval provenance.

The approval-semantic identity should cover at minimum, using existing authoritative approved evidence where available:

* segment ID / UUID and order
* approved source identity/fingerprint binding
* source in/out
* speed / timeline duration semantics
* effective audio role
* audio volume/fade contract
* relevant approved audio/profile fields that affect segment audio output

Runtime-only fields must NOT affect it:

* resolved encoder implementation/contract
* encoder probe diagnostics
* segment renderer/cache contract version
* artifact path/cache key
* transient execution metadata

## Render Report contract

Formal Render must emit/record the same approval-semantic identity for each segment from the actual manifest inputs it rendered.

Delivery QA must compare the ordered approved semantic identities vs ordered rendered semantic identities exactly and fail closed on:

* count mismatch
* missing identity
* reordering
* source/timing/speed/audio semantic mutation

Do not simply stop checking provenance and do not downgrade mismatches to warning.

Keep render cache key evidence separately in the report for artifact/cache auditability.

## Compatibility / migration

* Do not mutate or backfill the existing revision-8 approval snapshot manually.
* Prefer a deterministic identity computable from the existing approved manifest/snapshot plus authoritative source fingerprint fields, so the current accepted revision can remain valid if product currentity permits.
* If a schema/version field is required for the new provenance contract, version it explicitly.
* A runtime encoder change alone must not require re-approval.

## Required regressions

 1. Same approved segment/audio semantics, raw approval manifest vs resolved NVENC runtime contract -> provenance identity equal.
 2. Same semantics with different `nvenc_probe.stderr_tail`, encoder implementation/cache contract version -> provenance identity equal.
 3. Change audio role/volume/fade -> identity differs and Delivery QA blocks.
 4. Change source in/out or speed -> identity differs and blocks.
 5. Change source approved fingerprint -> identity differs and blocks.
 6. Reorder segments -> ordered comparison blocks.
 7. Missing/extra Render Report segment -> blocks.
 8. Render cache keys may legitimately differ while semantic provenance passes.
 9. Existing BGM fingerprint/provenance validation remains unchanged and fail-closed.
10. <issue id="3ab58c7c-56b9-4bf2-a838-f78cdd67e6a4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-36/formal-render-segment-cache-must-bind-resolved-encoder-contract">VID-36</issue> segment cache tests remain PASS; do not weaken resolved encoder cache binding.

## Acceptance / rerun boundary

After implementation + PR review/CI, do **not** immediately rerender the 60-minute Coffee job if the existing output/report can be safely re-evaluated by the corrected Delivery QA against immutable evidence. First determine whether a Delivery-QA-only rerun on successful Render `a1eef04442f74adeb603b1b6f11b2ba9` is authoritative under product contracts.

* If yes: rerun only a NEW Delivery QA against that unchanged output/report.
* If no because the Render Report lacks the new semantic provenance evidence and it cannot be derived without changing the report contract: explain exactly why a new Render is required before doing it.

No manual FFmpeg, DB patch, approval mutation, cache deletion, threshold weakening, or special-case whitelist for this run.

issue.title: Formal Render GPU pipeline｜NVDEC → CUDA filters → NVENC
issue.description:
## Goal

Make the formal segment Render pipeline use GPU decode + GPU video filters + GPU encode on supported NVIDIA systems:

`NVDEC -> CUDA filters -> NVENC`

This is now part of <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> Round 1 deliverable DoD, not merely a future performance experiment.

## Existing evidence

<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> isolated Coffee smoke on the same Windows/NVIDIA host demonstrated:

* source: 4K HEVC 10-bit Coffee, first 8 seconds
* output: H.264 1920x1080 yuv420p 30fps, same h264_nvenc p5/vbr/cq23 intent
* CPU decode + CPU scale + NVENC: 22.185s
* NVDEC + `scale_cuda` + NVENC: 1.471s
* \~15.1x wall-clock improvement
* GPU command used `-hwaccel cuda -hwaccel_output_format cuda` and `scale_cuda=1920:1080:format=yuv420p`
* output decoded successfully; RTX 5070 Ti / driver 610.62

The current full formal Render `a1eef04442f74adeb603b1b6f11b2ba9` proves 17/17 NVENC encode but still decodes/scales/filter-processes on CPU and took 3621.793s for an 87.517313s output. Preserve that as the pre-NVDEC baseline.

## Required design

Add a versioned formal GPU execution contract distinct from approval semantics. On a supported NVIDIA path, segment rendering should use hardware decode and CUDA-compatible filters while retaining the existing approved output/profile semantics.

At minimum define/persist audit evidence for:

* decode requested / implementation (`nvdec` vs CPU)
* hardware device/API
* filter path requested / implementation (`cuda` vs CPU)
* concrete GPU filter chain used
* encoder implementation / existing encoder contract
* whether any stage fell back and why
* bounded diagnostics for failed capability/compatibility probes

Runtime GPU execution details belong in render/cache identity where they materially change the rendered artifact, but must not pollute approval-semantic provenance identity (see <issue id="6170ce99-f62a-4dee-b0ee-4eb0f3262f20" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-37/delivery-qa-audio-provenanceseparate-approval-semantic-identity-from">VID-37</issue>).

## Capability / compatibility

Do not assume every source/filter combination can remain entirely in CUDA frames.

Formal implementation must explicitly handle source and filter compatibility, including current Coffee HEVC 10-bit input. If an approved video operation is not available in CUDA, either:

1. use a documented, deterministic transfer/CPU-filter path with explicit audit evidence, or
2. fail/fallback according to a versioned execution policy.

Do not silently claim `gpu_pipeline` when frames were downloaded and the material transform happened on CPU.

## Cache identity

Segment artifact cache identity must distinguish materially different execution contracts. Existing <issue id="3ab58c7c-56b9-4bf2-a838-f78cdd67e6a4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-36/formal-render-segment-cache-must-bind-resolved-encoder-contract">VID-36</issue> resolved encoder binding remains intact.

Add the GPU decode/filter execution contract/version to cache identity if required so a CPU-decode artifact cannot masquerade as proof of the new formal GPU pipeline.

Do not manually clear cache as acceptance evidence.

## Fallback semantics

For `auto` mode, CPU fallback is allowed only if explicitly specified by the formal execution contract and must be visible in Render Report. For <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> final acceptance on the RTX 5070 Ti host, the 17 Coffee segments must actually demonstrate the expected GPU decode/filter path; a silent or wholesale CPU fallback does not satisfy this child.

Existing formal NVENC fail-closed rules remain unchanged.

## Output / QA invariants

Do not weaken or change:

* approved timeline/content semantics
* profile dimensions/fps/pixel format/audio contract
* source immutability
* Render Report / Final QC checks
* Delivery QA thresholds
* <issue id="52ee49da-6210-478c-a0ec-4f8ee08f2a85" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-32/formal-delivery-qa-blockerchapter-cards-produce-interior-black">VID-32</issue> visual behavior
* <issue id="6170ce99-f62a-4dee-b0ee-4eb0f3262f20" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-37/delivery-qa-audio-provenanceseparate-approval-semantic-identity-from">VID-37</issue> provenance design

Final output must remain valid under the same current Final QC and Delivery QA contracts.

## Required implementation evidence

Before a full Coffee Render, use isolated deterministic A/B fixtures/smokes to prove:

* CPU decode/filter + same NVENC output path works
* NVDEC/CUDA-filter + same NVENC output path works
* output stream contract matches expected 1080p H.264/yuv420p/30fps target
* representative duration/timestamp/audio behavior remains valid
* unsupported GPU decode/filter condition produces explicit fallback/failure evidence
* cache identity differs appropriately between CPU execution and GPU execution contracts
* repeated identical GPU contract can legally hit cache

## Required regressions

At minimum cover:

 1. supported NVIDIA source -> execution resolves NVDEC + CUDA filter + NVENC.
 2. emitted FFmpeg command uses hardware decode/output frames and CUDA filter chain correctly.
 3. unsupported/missing CUDA/NVDEC -> explicit deterministic fallback/failure audit, never silent.
 4. source/pixel-format combination requiring conversion is handled deterministically.
 5. CPU vs GPU execution contract cannot share an artifact cache identity when implementation differs materially.
 6. identical GPU semantic execution contract remains deterministic/cacheable.
 7. runtime diagnostic text does not make semantic cache identity nondeterministic.
 8. <issue id="069af1e3-ef10-4d53-a96c-f5f8d36fb29f" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-33/render-nvenc-capability-probe避免合法-gpu-被-16x16-probe-誤判">VID-33</issue> encoder contract tests remain PASS.
 9. <issue id="3ab58c7c-56b9-4bf2-a838-f78cdd67e6a4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-36/formal-render-segment-cache-must-bind-resolved-encoder-contract">VID-36</issue> segment cache resolved encoder tests remain PASS.
10. <issue id="af040022-b934-471a-97ef-4ac9c4784789" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-31/render-performancesource-ffprobe-去重與-fast-metadata-path">VID-31</issue> source fast-probe/reuse remains PASS.
11. Final QC/output stream fixture remains PASS.

## Acceptance sequence

Do not run the full \~60-minute Coffee formal Render merely to prove implementation before PR review.

Sequence:

1. implement focused Draft PR
2. isolated Coffee A/B / targeted media smoke
3. targeted + full tests / Windows CI
4. ChatGPT review + merge
5. only after <issue id="6170ce99-f62a-4dee-b0ee-4eb0f3262f20" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-37/delivery-qa-audio-provenanceseparate-approval-semantic-identity-from">VID-37</issue> and this child are both merged, perform one new authoritative <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> Coffee Formal Render -> Render Report / Final QC -> new Delivery QA -> human preview

Final <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> render must capture stage-level timing and GPU execution audit. Compare against the pre-NVDEC baseline 3621.793s without inventing estimates.

## VID-38 review blocker fixed

- PR #104: https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/pull/104
- Branch: `agent/vid-38`
- HEAD: `3ef5570`
- Base: `fbc65caebc50549fdd747ffbb092c575ebb4c086`
- PR remains Draft; no full 17-segment Coffee Render was run.

### Final-cache currentity

Before accepting an existing final cache, the same job-scoped `SourceProbeRegistry` and `GPUExecutionRegistry` now resolve every ordered manifest segment against current source/profile/host state. The implementation exact-compares:

- report GPU contract version/hash/implementation vs current resolved ordered contracts
- report ordered segment IDs/cache keys vs current expected segment artifact keys

The same registries are reused if the cache misses and rendering continues, preserving VID-31 fast unique-source probe reuse.

Regressions cover:
- old auto/CPU fallback -> current NVDEC/CUDA: final cache MISS
- same current NVDEC/CUDA: HIT
- diagnostic/stderr differences with the same semantic hash: HIT
- changed semantic hash or expected segment cache key: MISS
- source probe registry reuse
- VID-36 cache identity and VID-37 approval provenance unchanged

### Real isolated Coffee A/B follow-up

Same 4K HEVC 10-bit source, same 8-second formal `render_segment()` path and h264_nvenc p5/vbr/cq23 contract:

- CPU: 24.588s, cache key `cc54142e...`
- NVDEC/CUDA: 1.938s, cache key `c75c4322...`
- repeated NVDEC/CUDA: `cache_hit=true`, same key
- CPU/GPU both: H.264 1920x1080 yuv420p, 30/1, 240 frames, 8.000000s
- both: color_space=bt709, color_primaries=bt709, color_transfer=bt709, color_range=tv
- both: AAC 48000 Hz stereo, audio duration 7.946896s
- container bitrate: CPU 1,690,552 bps; GPU 4,564,237 bps. This is recorded as a bitrate difference; no stream/profile/frame/audio contract mismatch remains.
- GPU audit: `implementation=nvdec_cuda`, `decode_used=nvdec`, `filter_used=cuda`, RTX 5070 Ti, capability probe PASS.

### Validation

- Targeted final-cache/GPU/segment/project/provenance/QC: 72 passed
- Project renderer/media-probe e2e: 18 passed
- Full Python: 784 passed, 2 skipped
- Frontend: 262 passed
- Frontend production build: PASS
- compileall, UTF-8, git diff --check: PASS
- CI run `31947903806`: Frontend, Media Smoke / Ubuntu, Ubuntu portability / Python 3.13, Windows authoritative / Python 3.11, and Select PR test layers all PASS

Ready for ChatGPT review.

### ChatGPT review blocker — final render cache is not bound to current resolved GPU execution

PR #104 HEAD `1e8721a3951cb44592f9afcb6dd8dba4e184f942` has the intended segment-level GPU execution contract and segment-cache binding, and CI is green. However, do not merge yet.

`project_renderer._final_cache_miss_reason()` no longer recomputes/compares the current resolved per-segment artifact identity. It only checks GPU execution contract version, requested mode, evidence presence, and non-empty segment cache keys.

That allows this incorrect sequence:

1. `gpu_execution=auto`, CUDA temporarily unavailable -> formal Render explicitly falls back to CPU decode/filter + NVENC and publishes a final cache.
2. CUDA later becomes available.
3. Same approved render is requested.
4. Final cache can still hit because request remains `auto` and old report has v1 GPU evidence.
5. Render returns before current `GPUExecutionRegistry.resolve()` / segment cache currentity, so old CPU-decode output masquerades as the currently expected NVDEC/CUDA execution.

This violates VID-38 cache semantics.

Required fix:
- bind final-cache currentity to the **currently resolved ordered per-segment GPU execution semantic contracts** and corresponding expected segment artifact keys;
- ideally resolve with the same job-scoped `SourceProbeRegistry` + `GPUExecutionRegistry` before final-cache acceptance, then reuse those registries if rendering proceeds, preserving VID-31 probe dedupe;
- CPU-fallback `auto` artifact -> current NVDEC/CUDA must MISS;
- identical current NVDEC/CUDA -> HIT;
- diagnostics/timing/stderr must not affect identity;
- approval provenance remains unchanged;
- no manual cache deletion.

Add regressions for CPU-fallback→GPU-available miss and GPU→same-GPU hit.

Non-blocking evidence follow-up: current real A/B output sizes differ materially (CPU 1,770,042 B vs GPU 4,789,167 B). Include frame count/bitrate and color metadata (`color_space`, primaries, transfer, range) in the next A/B report to confirm output-profile semantics are unchanged; only change implementation if evidence shows a contract mismatch.

PR comment with the same blocker is recorded on #104.

## VID-38 implementation handoff

- Base: `fbc65caebc50549fdd747ffbb092c575ebb4c086`
- Branch: `agent/vid-38`
- Draft PR: [#104](https://github.com/DystopiaOwO/video-vault-ai/pull/104)
- HEAD: `1e8721a3951cb44592f9afcb6dd8dba4e184f942`

### Implementation

Added versioned GPU execution contract `1` for formal segment rendering. When the resolved encoder is h264_nvenc and the source/profile are supported, the emitted path is NVDEC -> CUDA filter -> h264_nvenc, with `-hwaccel cuda`, `-hwaccel_output_format cuda`, and `scale_cuda=1920:1080:format=yuv420p`. Unsupported/unavailable paths have structured, bounded capability evidence and deterministic explicit CPU fallback; there is no silent fallback.

VID-37 approval provenance remains semantic-only. GPU execution fields, device, diagnostics, renderer/cache contract, and timing do not enter approval provenance. VID-36 resolved encoder binding remains required. CPU/GPU segment cache identities differ; identical GPU contracts cache-hit deterministically; diagnostic stderr changes do not change semantic cache identity. VID-31 source fast-probe/reuse remains in the hot path. Final QC and Delivery QA contracts were not changed.

### Real isolated Coffee A/B

Same 4K HEVC 10-bit Coffee source, 8-second slice, final_1080p, same h264_nvenc p5/vbr/cq23 contract:

- CPU decode/filter + NVENC: 22.715s, 1,770,042 bytes.
- NVDEC + scale_cuda + NVENC: 1.883s, 4,789,167 bytes.
- Measured speedup: 12.1x.
- GPU resolved audit: `implementation=nvdec_cuda`, `decode_used=nvdec`, `filter_used=cuda`, `hardware_api=cuda`, RTX 5070 Ti; output H.264 1920x1080 yuv420p 30fps with valid A/V.
- Repeated identical GPU run: cache hit with the same key.
- Source SHA/size/mtime and production data unchanged.

No full 17-segment Coffee Formal Render was run, per VID-38 stop rule.

### Validation

- Targeted media/render/provenance/QC: 68 passed.
- Full Python: 781 passed, 2 skipped.
- Frontend: 262 passed.
- Frontend production build: PASS.
- compileall, UTF-8, and git diff --check: PASS.

issue.title: Formal Render display geometry｜尊重 SAR / DAR / rotation / Display Matrix，避免 framing 失真
issue.description:
## Human-preview blocker

<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> 最終 human preview 明確失敗：成品畫面 framing / 顯示幾何與原始素材播放器看到的畫面不一致。使用者提供對照截圖；不是剪輯方向，也不是單純 90°/180° rotation 問題。

目前 `MediaProbe` 只保存 coded width/height，沒有 sample_aspect_ratio、display_aspect_ratio、rotation、Display Matrix。<issue id="0498d23c-b4fb-4d41-8956-95062cf3feee" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-38/formal-render-gpu-pipelinenvdec-cuda-filters-nvenc">VID-38</issue> CUDA path 又直接使用 `scale_cuda=<target_w>:<target_h>`，因此目前 product 可能把 coded geometry 當 display geometry。

## Goal

建立 deterministic display-geometry contract，讓正式 Render 尊重 source 的實際顯示幾何，並讓 CPU / NVDEC+CUDA path 產生一致 framing。

## Required investigation

對 <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> authoritative Coffee sources 做 read-only ffprobe inventory：

* coded width / height
* sample_aspect_ratio (SAR)
* display_aspect_ratio (DAR)
* `tags.rotate`
* `side_data_list` / Display Matrix rotation
* stream/container orientation metadata
* FFmpeg CPU decode default autorotate 行為
* `-hwaccel cuda -hwaccel_output_format cuda` 下 autorotate / display matrix 行為

同時對比：

* source player screenshot / representative source frame
* current formal segment output frame
* current final output frame

不要先假設固定旋轉角度，也不要硬編碼 Coffee 特例。

## Required design

`MediaProbe` / source probe contract 應保存 normalized display geometry，至少：

* coded_width / coded_height
* sar
* dar / normalized display width-height ratio
* rotation degrees / display matrix provenance

Render 必須根據 display geometry 決定：

* autorotate / transpose / CUDA-compatible transform
* preserve-aspect scale
* crop / pad policy（不得 silent stretch）

GPU path 不得直接把非等比例 display geometry 強制 `scale_cuda=1920:1080`。

如果 CUDA 無法安全表達所需 transform：

* 明確 mixed/CPU fallback，或 fail closed
* audit 實際 execution path
* 不得宣稱 full CUDA framing correctness

## Cache / provenance

Display geometry / transform 會影響 pixels，必須進 render artifact cache identity。
不得進 <issue id="6170ce99-f62a-4dee-b0ee-4eb0f3262f20" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-37/delivery-qa-audio-provenanceseparate-approval-semantic-identity-from">VID-37</issue> approval semantic provenance，除非 approved visual semantics 本身明確綁 display transform。

舊錯誤 geometry artifact 必須自然 MISS，不人工清 cache。

## QA

新增 representative frame geometry regression：

* source displayed framing vs rendered framing 的 aspect/transform contract 可驗證
* portrait / landscape / non-square-pixel / rotated metadata fixtures
* CPU vs GPU output geometry一致
* no silent stretch

Final QC / Delivery QA 應至少能 audit source display geometry → render transform → output geometry；不要再只驗 output=1920x1080 就算 PASS。

## Acceptance

先用 <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> Coffee source 做小片段/單幀 A/B，確認與使用者第二張對照圖的 framing 方向一致，再跑完整 Coffee Render。

不要重跑 Perception / Story / Apply / Approval。
不要先跑完整 17-segment Render。

issue.description:
## 目標

把目前 Creative Brief + Visual Style Preview 從「控制項優先」改成「結果優先」：

**AI 推薦 → 真實 Preview → 一鍵採用；只有不滿意時才展開詳細設定。**

這是接下來優先於 Timeline Inspector 的 UX 重構，不新增新的剪輯 engine 能力。

## 主流程（Simple mode）

首頁/主要 creative flow 只保留三個高價值步驟：

### 1. 影片方向

只顯示：

* 橫向 16:9
* 直向 9:16
* AI 推薦 badge + 一句理由

主要 CTA：`採用推薦方向` 或直接點另一方向。

framing strategy 不直接攤開；只顯示人話摘要，例如：

`直向素材將優先裁切，必要時使用模糊背景補齊。`

### 2. 視覺風格 Preview

直接顯示真實素材 Preview cards：

* Diary Natural（Recommended）
* Clean Minimal
* Cinematic

每張卡只顯示：

* 真實畫面
* style 名稱
* 1 句描述
* Recommended badge（若適用）

主要 CTA：`使用這個風格`。

不要在主畫面同時顯示 font / weight / anchor / readability / motion 等 controls。

### 3. 確認

顯示單行或 compact summary，例如：

`16:9 · Diary Natural · 直向素材自動補背景 · Overlay 字卡`

主要 CTA：`確認並開始剪輯`。

## Advanced / Progressive Disclosure

Simple flow 每一步可有 `詳細設定` / `微調`，預設收起。

Advanced 使用 accordion 分組，避免一次展開所有 controls。

建議 group：

* 畫面配置：crop / background / preserve full frame
* 視覺與調色：grading / LUT summary + available look controls
* 字卡：title style / position / readability / motion
* 字幕：只保留入口與摘要；字幕審核、字型 registry、caption workflow 由獨立字幕任務負責
* 技術資訊：capability/provenance/debug，只在更深層 diagnostic 區

主流程不得要求使用者理解 internal contract ID。

## One source of truth

Simple 與 Advanced 必須操作既有 <issue id="537ca3ee-e421-4404-8149-4d4baee0f20c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-26/creative-brief一次完成-ai-建議與創意核准">VID-26</issue> / <issue id="ed771ad6-fea2-497e-94be-d3fd29275b0c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-27/visual-style-preview用真實素材先核准字幕與視覺方向">VID-27</issue> 同一份 persisted semantic contracts。

禁止：

* 建立 `simple_settings` 第二份設定資料
* Simple CTA 直接繞過正式 approval
* UI-only recommendation state 被當成 approved state

`採用推薦` 必須等價於：

1. resolve current AI recommendation
2. materialize exact semantic contract
3. 需要 Preview 的項目先產生/驗證 preview evidence
4. human click
5. 正式 approval persistence

## State / invalidation

* Advanced 任一 pixel-affecting override 改變 → 舊 Visual Style preview evidence stale，要求重新 Preview。
* 純 disclosure 展開/收合不影響 semantic hash。
* visual-only changes 不 stale Story / Perception。
* Creative Brief visual contract 改變時 Visual Style currentity 維持既有 fail-closed 規則。

## 字幕任務邊界

本任務不重新設計：

* 字幕審核 workflow
* 中文字幕字型清單 / font registry
* caption timing/text editing
* subtitle renderer contract

若字幕獨立任務新增設定，本任務只要求它可透過同一 Simple/Advanced disclosure contract 插入，不讓主畫面變密集。

## Horizontal Extensibility Contract

這裡有理論上可以水平增加的東西：設定 section / summary item / advanced control group。

建立最小 versioned disclosure metadata contract，例如：

* section_id（stable）
* schema/version
* human label
* disclosure_level: primary / advanced / diagnostic
* order
* capability/enabled state
* summary resolver identity
* affected semantic domain / invalidation class

前端由 metadata 決定 section placement/order/state；不要在主容器散落 `if section === ...`。

不要求 generic plugin framework。

至少提供一個 synthetic sibling section fixture，證明可加入 Advanced 與 summary，而不修改主流程核心 branch。

## UI quality

* desktop 首屏要有明確視覺層級與足夠留白。
* 不要卡片、select、badge 全部擠在一起。
* Progressive disclosure 展開前，Advanced controls 不佔主要視覺空間。
* 內部名稱轉成使用者語言；例如 `background_treatment` → `模糊背景補齊`。
* Technical provenance/hash 不放在一般主流程；仍可在 diagnostic/debug drill-down 取得。

## Acceptance

以 authoritative Coffee project 驗收：

 1. 首屏不再看到 <issue id="537ca3ee-e421-4404-8149-4d4baee0f20c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-26/creative-brief一次完成-ai-建議與創意核准">VID-26</issue>/27 現有整排 Advanced selects。
 2. 從未設定狀態開始，一般路徑最多 3 個主要決策：方向 → style → 確認。
 3. AI recommendation 清楚但不自動替 human 核准。
 4. Visual Style 必須先看真實 Preview 才能 approve。
 5. 展開 Advanced 可修改 framing/title/grading；收起後 summary 即時反映 effective persisted values。
 6. 修改 Advanced 後舊 preview 失效，不能用 stale preview approve。
 7. refresh / restart 後 semantic state 正確；不需要保存純 UI accordion state。
 8. Story/Perception identity 不因 visual-only UI 操作改變。
 9. synthetic setting section 透過 disclosure metadata 加入，不需修改主流程 special-case。
10. frontend responsive/build/tests PASS。

## Scope guard

本任務只重構 UI / UX orchestration 與 disclosure metadata。

不要：

* full Coffee Render
* 重跑 Perception / Story / Apply
* 實作 Timeline Inspector
* 實作 Editorial Policy
* 擴字幕 engine
* 修改 source media
* 弱化 approval/currentity/provenance contracts

issue.title: Editor Workflow v2｜從素材匯入到成片的主流程重構
issue.description:
## 定位

重新設計 Video Vault AI 的整體使用流程，不只是在既有 Creative Brief / Visual Style 上做 UI 簡化。

目標是把目前偏「pipeline / contract 導向」的操作，改成真正的 **AI 剪片助手工作流**：

**素材進來 → AI 自動理解與整理 → 使用者只在高價值節點做決策 → AI 產生可看的剪輯結果 → 使用者進入對應 Workspace 微調 → 最後核准與輸出。**

現有 Perception、Creative Brief、Story、Visual Style、Audio、Render、QC、Approval、Provenance 等後端能力原則上保留；本任務先重新決定「什麼時候出現、誰先誰後、哪些自動、哪些必須人工確認」。

## 為什麼需要獨立 Workflow v2

<issue id="18a7a130-9a21-4265-98f6-e35bcf672ac8" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-40/simple-first-editor-uxprogressive-disclosure-與三步創意流程">VID-40</issue> 目前只負責現有 Creative Brief + Visual Style 的 Simple-first / Progressive Disclosure，不應承擔整個產品流程重排。

Workflow v2 需要重新評估：

* Project 首頁到底顯示什麼
* 匯入素材後哪些分析自動開始
* Perception / transcription / audio analysis 的先後與併行關係
* AI 何時產生第一版 Story / rough cut
* 使用者何時決定影片方向、長度、風格
* Timeline Inspector 是主流程還是 drill-down
* 字幕何時生成、何時審核、與 rough cut timing 如何互相影響
* 調色 / BGM / Audio / Title / Subtitle 應該是獨立 Workspace 還是同一 Review 階段
* Approval 應該有哪些 checkpoint，避免每一層 contract 都要求使用者理解
* Preview / Draft / Final Render 的差異與成本

## Product principles

1. **Result-first**：先給 AI 建議或可看的結果，不先給一堆參數。
2. **Progressive disclosure**：一般流程只出現必要決策，詳細設定再展開。
3. **Workspace-oriented**：需要人工精修的能力進獨立 Workspace，而不是塞進主流程表單。
4. **One source of truth**：新流程只能 orchestration 現有 persisted semantic contracts，不建立第二套 UI-only 狀態。
5. **Human-in-the-loop at value points**：人工確認應集中在真正影響創作方向或成片的節點。
6. **Cheap preview before expensive render**：能用 proxy / local preview 解決的，不先跑完整 render。
7. **AI-first but reversible**：AI 可以自動完成大量工作，但每個人工改動都可追蹤、可撤回、可重新生成受影響部分。

## 必須納入的新能力

### Subtitle Workspace

字幕不是單一輸出選項，而是正式 editing workspace：

* transcription / word timestamp
* 繁中自動斷句
* cue timeline
* waveform
* 文字直接編輯
* split / merge
* 拖曳 start/end
* 即時樣式預覽
* 約 10 組可再散布的開源繁中文字型
* 使用者匯入 TTF / OTF
* safe zone
* search / replace
* undo / redo
* AI 校字 / 專有名詞 / 斷句建議

UX 可借鑑 WhatSub 等 browser-based subtitle editor 的操作概念，但所有程式碼、UI 與資料模型獨立實作，不依賴 WhatSub。

## 與既有工作關係

* <issue id="667da9da-b54d-4cf7-b1a2-a8034eef3256" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-25/ai-editor-ux-v1simple-first-creative-flowstyle-previewtimeline">VID-25</issue>：現有 AI Editor UX epic，視 Workflow v2 結論決定保留、縮小或重新定位。
* <issue id="18a7a130-9a21-4265-98f6-e35bcf672ac8" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-40/simple-first-editor-uxprogressive-disclosure-與三步創意流程">VID-40</issue>：目前 Simple-first Creative Flow 可繼續作為局部 UX 原則與元件驗證，但不可反過來限制 Workflow v2。
* <issue id="aa20b1ac-06a1-47fa-b137-39e4c3159fc4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-28/timeline-inspectorfilmstrip-waveform-perception-drill-down">VID-28</issue>：Timeline Inspector 先保留，不急著實作；等 Workflow v2 決定它在主流程的位置。
* <issue id="3f8e20e8-b136-4fa5-b3d6-7bae464faa34" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-29/editorial-policy-v1把剪輯-craft-變成可版本化決策規則">VID-29</issue>：Editorial Policy 等 Workflow v2 基本穩定後再做。

## 第一階段 DoD：流程設計，不急著改 engine

先完成一份可實作的 Workflow v2 contract：

* 新主流程階段與順序
* 每個階段輸入 / 輸出
* 自動執行 vs 人工 checkpoint
* Workspace 資訊架構
* semantic state ownership
* stale / invalidation 邊界
* Preview / Draft / Final render 層級
* 各既有 VID 任務的保留 / 合併 / 重排清單
* Subtitle Workspace 在流程中的確切位置

完成後再拆 implementation issues；不要在流程未定前一次改完整產品。

UX 借鑑 WhatSub 等 browser-based subtitle editor 的操作概念，但所有程式碼、UI、資料模型與渲染 contract 皆獨立實作，不依賴或複製 WhatSub。

## 核心資料層

建立 versioned caption track / cue contract，至少保留：

* language（第一版 zh-TW）
* transcript revision
* cue id
* cue start / end
* cue text
* word-level timestamps
* manual edit provenance
* style reference / optional cue-level override

word timestamp 必須保留，支援重新斷句、split/merge、逐字高亮與 transcript-based editing。

## Transcription / 中文斷句

* speech-to-text provider contract
* word timestamp
* 繁中 punctuation normalization
* 中文語意斷句
* 避免把詞拆開
* 過長 cue / 過短孤句偵測
* 可重新產生 cue，但不得覆蓋已核准人工修改而不提示
* 專有名詞 / 使用者字典的擴充點

## Subtitle Workspace UX

主畫面至少包含：

* 影片 preview
* waveform
* caption cue timeline
* cue list / text editor
* 點 cue 跳到時間
* 直接修改文字
* drag cue start/end
* split cue
* merge cue
* delete / restore
* search / replace
* undo / redo
* safe-zone overlay
* style preview

需要與 Workflow v2 的 Simple-first 原則配合：主流程只顯示字幕是否啟用、AI 推薦 style summary 與「進入字幕校正」入口；完整控制只在 Workspace 出現。

## Font Library v1

內建約 10 個適合繁體中文影片字幕的開源 font families，必須逐一確認可再散布授權與 notice 義務。

預期包含不同用途：

* 萬用黑體
* 明體
* 圓體
* 手寫
* 文楷
* 粗 display
* 復古 / 人文
* pixel / retro

要求：

* family 與 weight 分離
* 不依賴 Windows 已安裝字型
* registry 記錄 stable id / family / version / source / license / files / checksum
* runtime 可確定解析到指定 font，不可 silent fallback
* 支援使用者匯入 TTF / OTF
* bundled/downloaded font 授權資訊進 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES / font registry

## Style / Render contract

盡量延伸既有 <issue id="ed771ad6-fea2-497e-94be-d3fd29275b0c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-27/visual-style-preview用真實素材先核准字幕與視覺方向">VID-27</issue> Visual / Title Style semantic contract，不建立第二套互不相容的字幕樣式系統。

至少支援：

* font family
* weight
* size
* text / outline / shadow / background colors
* outline width
* background surface
* alignment / anchor / margins
* line width / max lines
* safe-zone policy

Preview 與 Final Render 必須使用同一 resolved semantic style，避免 WebUI 看起來與輸出不同。

## AI 輔助

第一版 contract 預留：

* AI 錯字檢查
* 專有名詞修正建議
* 重新斷句建議
* 根據影片類型推薦 subtitle preset
* 根據畫面重要區域建議位置

AI 建議不得直接覆寫人工已核准字幕。

## 與其他任務關係

* Workflow v2 決定 Subtitle Workspace 在整體流程中的確切 checkpoint。
* <issue id="ed771ad6-fea2-497e-94be-d3fd29275b0c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-27/visual-style-preview用真實素材先核准字幕與視覺方向">VID-27</issue> 現有 title / caption style contract 優先重用。
* <issue id="aa20b1ac-06a1-47fa-b137-39e4c3159fc4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-28/timeline-inspectorfilmstrip-waveform-perception-drill-down">VID-28</issue> Timeline Inspector 的 waveform / timeline primitives 若可共用，應抽共用元件，不做兩套 timeline。

## DoD

* 真實 zh-TW 語音素材可產生 word-level transcript + cues。
* WebUI 可以完成至少文字修改、split/merge、拖時間與播放定位。
* 10 組 font families 具明確來源/授權/版本資訊且可穩定 preview/render。
* 使用者可匯入 TTF/OTF。
* Preview 與 Final Render 字幕位置/字型/尺寸/描邊一致。
* 修改字幕只 stale subtitle/render 相關 evidence，不無故 stale Perception / Story。
* refresh / restart 後 caption edits 與 provenance 完整保存。
* frontend/backend tests + Windows 真實流程驗收 PASS。

issue.description:
## Context

<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> 最終 Coffee 視覺核准 checkpoint 在 latest main `41486358700a65453e9afcd17c69f5e6ca170a7f` 被 WebUI 主頁本身阻塞。

Isolated workspace：
`C:\Users\b3b3b\Documents\AI剪片助手\video-vault-ai-vid18-acceptance-4b62c8c`

開啟：
`http://127.0.0.1:8765/?project_id=1`

server 於 `src/video_vault/ui.py::_jobs_panel()` 失敗：

`TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'float' and 'str'`

目前實作直接：

`sorted(jobs, key=lambda j: j.get('updated_at', 0), reverse=True)`

而實際 jobs payload 同時存在 numeric Unix timestamp 與 string timestamp。

## Goal

讓 WebUI jobs panel 對合法歷史/現行 job timestamp representation 都能 deterministic 排序，不修改 job semantic state、不 patch DB/JOBS payload。

## Required implementation

* 建立單一 presentation-level timestamp sort-key normalizer / parser。
* 至少接受：
  * `int` / `float` Unix seconds
  * ISO-8601 string，含 timezone offset 與 `Z`
  * missing / empty / invalid value
* 所有合法值轉成同一 sortable scalar / tuple。
* invalid/missing 必須有 deterministic fallback，不可讓 panel crash。
* 不要 in-place rewrite `jobs` / `JOBS` / persisted DB。
* 保持 newest-first。
* ties 必須 deterministic；若現有 input order 要靠 Python stable sort 保留，測試明確鎖定。
* 不要 producer-specific `if kind == ...` 分支。

## Horizontal extensibility

這裡有理論上可水平增加的 job producer。未來 background jobs 可能來自不同 domain / persistence layer，因此 timestamp normalization 應集中在 presentation boundary，而不是每新增一種 job 就修改 `_jobs_panel()` special-case。

不需要建立 generic job framework。

## Regression tests

至少覆蓋：

1. numeric + ISO string mixed list 不 crash。
2. newest-first ordering 正確。
3. `Z` / `+08:00` 等 timezone string 可比較。
4. invalid / missing timestamp deterministic fallback。
5. equal timestamps ordering deterministic / stable。
6. `_jobs_panel()` 能完整 render HTML，原 status/progress/stop button semantics 不變。

若發現 job serialization API 可以合理地統一 timestamp format，可以另外補 producer regression，但仍不得依賴資料 migration 才能讓舊 payload 正常顯示。

## Scope guard

不要：

* 修改 Coffee DB / job payload 來繞過 bug
* Creative Brief autoapproval
* Visual Style autoapproval
* 產生 Visual Style Preview
* Perception / Story / Apply / Approval rerun
* Formal Render / Final QC / Delivery QA
* <issue id="bf98f67c-bb56-436f-9fc8-c79d49aa36af" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-42/subtitle-workspace-v1逐字稿時間軸繁中字型與人工校正">VID-42</issue> / <issue id="aa20b1ac-06a1-47fa-b137-39e4c3159fc4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-28/timeline-inspectorfilmstrip-waveform-perception-drill-down">VID-28</issue> / <issue id="3f8e20e8-b136-4fa5-b3d6-7bae464faa34" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-29/editorial-policy-v1把剪輯-craft-變成可版本化決策規則">VID-29</issue>
* unrelated render-job shutdown failure

## Acceptance

修正 merge 後，用原 isolated <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> workspace 重新開：

`http://127.0.0.1:8765/?project_id=1`

主頁必須正常 render，Creative Brief checkpoint 可由 human 操作；此 issue 本身不替 human 做 Creative Brief / Visual Style 決策。

完成後更新本 issue + <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> handoff，附 latest HEAD、tests、CI，停止交 ChatGPT review。

issue.title: Storage Workspace UX｜Artifact 明細預設收合與類型彙總
issue.description:
## Context

目前 `StorageWorkspace` 會在主畫面直接逐筆 render 最多 30 個 artifact：

* `source_media`
* `render_cache`
* 未來還會有 preview / subtitle / audio / QA 等 artifact

Coffee 真實驗收頁面已出現大量重複卡片，把 Creative Brief / Visual Style 等高價值決策往下推，與 <issue id="667da9da-b54d-4cf7-b1a2-a8034eef3256" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-25/ai-editor-ux-v1simple-first-creative-flowstyle-previewtimeline">VID-25</issue> / <issue id="18a7a130-9a21-4265-98f6-e35bcf672ac8" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-40/simple-first-editor-uxprogressive-disclosure-與三步創意流程">VID-40</issue> / <issue id="4fa12f54-8bd5-4af5-9727-afceb8f4a888" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-41/editor-workflow-v2從素材匯入到成片的主流程重構">VID-41</issue> 的 Simple-first / Progressive Disclosure 原則衝突。

Current implementation:

`web/src/workspaces/storage/StorageWorkspace.tsx`

目前直接：

`(summary?.artifacts || []).slice(0, 30).map(...)`

每個 artifact 都直接顯示 type / size / lifecycle / reference / pin button。

## Goal

把 Storage 從主流程中的「逐筆技術清單」改成：

**摘要 → 類型彙總 → 明細 drill-down**

一般使用者不應在主畫面先看到數十個 artifact 卡片。

## Required UX

### Default collapsed summary

Storage Workspace 預設只顯示 compact summary，例如：

* 已使用：2.5 GB
* 可清理：約 60 MB
* 受保護：2.4 GB
* Artifact：N 個
* 已釘選：N 個

並提供一個明確入口：

`查看儲存明細`

或 equivalent。

主畫面預設不得逐筆列出 artifact。

### Type aggregation

展開第一層後，先依 artifact semantic type 聚合，例如：

* 來源素材｜2 個｜2.51 GB
* Render Cache｜18 個｜420 MB
* Draft Preview｜N 個｜XX MB
* Subtitle Cache｜N 個｜XX MB

每組至少顯示：

* human label
* count
* total size
* protected / referenced / pinned summary where useful

### Per-artifact drill-down

只有使用者再展開某一 type group 時，才列出單筆 artifact。

單筆操作才顯示：

* lifecycle
* referenced / unreferenced
* pin/unpin
* artifact-specific details

不要讓每個 artifact 在主畫面直接出現一個按鈕。

## Copy / semantics

目前 `釘選輸出` 對 `source_media` 很不合理。

修正文案：

* generic artifact action：`釘選` / `解除釘選`
* 或依 semantic capability 顯示更精確文案

但不要讓 `source_media` 被描述成「輸出」。

如果某 artifact type 不應允許 user pin，應由 capability/metadata 決定，而不是 UI 用 type-name hard-code。

## Cleanup actions

`建立清理預覽` / `執行清理計畫` 保留，但應屬 Storage workspace 的進階操作，不應比 Creative Brief / Review 更搶視覺優先級。

清理安全 contract 不變：

* source
* approval
* formal output
* pinned
* referenced artifacts

不得因 UX 重構而改變 retention semantics。

## Horizontal extensibility

這裡有理論上可以水平增加的東西：YES。

未來 artifact types 會增加，例如：

* source_media
* render_cache
* draft_preview
* visual_style_preview
* subtitle_cache
* transcript
* audio_preview
* bgm_analysis
* QA evidence
* export artifact

因此第一版應建立最小 presentation descriptor / resolver contract，至少可提供：

* type id
* human label
* display order
* group/category
* pinnable / action capability
* disclosure level

新增 sibling artifact type 不應要求在 `StorageWorkspace` 核心 JSX 增加新的 `if type === ...` 分支。

不需要 universal artifact plugin framework。

可以是小 registry / metadata resolver + synthetic sibling regression。

## Simple-first boundary

Storage 不是 primary creative flow。

Project main UX 應優先：

Creative Intent / Brief
→ Preview / Review
→ human decision

Storage details 必須是 Advanced / maintenance drill-down。

不要因本任務重構整個 App navigation；只需讓 Storage 區塊本身符合 progressive disclosure。

## Scope guard

不要：

* 修改 retention / cleanup safety rules
* delete artifact
* patch Coffee DB
* Creative Brief approval
* Visual Style approval
* Visual Style Preview generation
* Perception / Story / Apply / Approval rerun
* Formal Render / Final QC / Delivery QA
* <issue id="bf98f67c-bb56-436f-9fc8-c79d49aa36af" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-42/subtitle-workspace-v1逐字稿時間軸繁中字型與人工校正">VID-42</issue> subtitle implementation
* <issue id="aa20b1ac-06a1-47fa-b137-39e4c3159fc4" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-28/timeline-inspectorfilmstrip-waveform-perception-drill-down">VID-28</issue> Timeline implementation
* Workflow v2 runtime implementation

## Regression / DoD

至少：

1. 30 個 artifact 時，default view 不再 render 30 張 item card。
2. Default view 只看得到 compact storage summary + disclosure affordance。
3. 展開後先看到 type aggregation。
4. 再展開 type 才看到 individual artifacts。
5. source_media 不再顯示 `釘選輸出`。
6. pin/unpin mutation semantics 保持不變。
7. cleanup preview/execute semantics 保持不變。
8. unknown / synthetic new artifact type 能透過同一 descriptor/resolver 出現在 aggregation，不需 core JSX special-case。
9. Coffee isolated project 頁面視覺 smoke：Storage 不再把 Creative Brief checkpoint 往下推成數十張 artifact cards。

## Handoff

建立 focused Draft PR。

完成後更新本 issue，附：

* baseline main
* branch / PR / HEAD
* before/after UX summary
* horizontal extensibility mechanism
* tests / build / CI
* Coffee page smoke

明確聲明：

`COFFEE CREATIVE BRIEF STATE NOT CHANGED`
`VISUAL STYLE STATE NOT CHANGED`
`FORMAL RENDER NOT RUN`

保持 Draft，停止交 ChatGPT review。
